item.title: Why The Bali 5.4 Should be Your Next Charter
item.description: The Bali 5.4 brings together space, comfort, and performance all in an impeccably designed 54-foot catamaran perfect for charter vacations. This yacht was built with a focus on open bright living spaces, comfortable accommodations, and plentiful outdoor spaces. With room for up to 12 in its six-cabin configuration, the Bali 5.4 is perfect for social sailing. Dream Yacht guests have the option to enjoy this yacht through a cabin cruise or when the yacht has availability outside of cabin charters, book it as a crewed yacht charter for an exclusive experience with family and friends. A Layout Designed for Living The center of the Bali 5.4’s design was built around bringing people together while still allowing space to spread out. Fluid flowing spaces from bow to stern creates seamless connection between the outdoor living areas, saloon, and aft cockpit. One of the most distinctive and innovative features of this yacht is the large pivoting rear door. It excellently connects the salon with the aft cockpit creating one extended living area and allowing for a larger conversation space. Another unique feature is the sliding windows that allow for more airflow and light giving an open air feel throughout. Forward of the saloon a door provides easy access to the foredeck. Here cushioned seats stretch out into the sun allowing guests to relax and enjoy the views while underway. While the aft cockpit provides a perfect gathering space for lunch or dinner at anchor with comfortable seating. The davits and swim ladder on the stern provide an easy access to the water for swimming. Then above there is a flybridge with a large U shaped seating area perfect for sipping a morning coffee with the sunrise or sundowners after a rewarding day of cruising. Forward of the seating area find the sunbathing pads where guests can lounge while taking in the breathtaking scenery of one of Dream Yacht’s incredible destinations. This Bali 5.4 provides so many areas where connection to the natural world and each other become possible. Find peace and shared experiences through innovation and exploration aboard this yacht. Take the Tour Comfortable Accommodations Below Deck The Bali 5.4 continues to deliver through its focus on comfort as we move below deck. Each cabin is equipped with queen sized beds, a private bathroom with a shower, and adequate storage space. Natural light and airflow are still features even down in the cabins; some cabins even have direct access to the deck. For large groups this layout is meant to give everyone their own private space at night, while relishing the communal spaces during the day. Guests get the feeling of home and settling in through these comfortable areas instead of the fleeting feeling of a hotel room. Why Charter the Bali 5.4 Space for Everyone – Roughly 130 square meters of living space allows for plenty of room to dine, relax, and enjoy cruising without feeling crowded. Indoor/Outdoor Living – The yacht’s flow from bow to stern and one of a kind opening door from the saloon to the aft cabin makes it easy to roam between the interior and exterior living spaces. Enjoy the breeze blowing through the yacht which creates a light airy open feel that connects you to the natural beauty of the surrounding world. Relaxation Area Options – There is no shortage of lounging areas onboard from the flybridge to the foredeck choose your ideal spot to enjoy the sail from. Now Newly Available for Private Crewed Charters When a Bali 5.4 is not being used on a cabin charter it will be available for a private crewed charter experience with a captain and hostess. This means families or groups of friends can experience the entire yacht privately, with a professional crew taking care of the sailing, itinerary, food, and day to day operation. Allowing guests to concentrate on relaxation and taking in the scenery from any of the comfortable lounging areas. item.title: BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience: Best Yacht Charter Options for Beginners
item.description: Picture waking up to the sound of waves against the hull of a catamaran anchored in a secluded cove in the British Virgin Islands (BVI). Walk on deck and soak up the sunshine and the spectacular views this area is famous for. It’s the perfect holiday, and the best part is that no sailing experience is needed. With Dream Yacht Worldwide , you can enjoy a BVI yacht vacation without having to know a jib from a mainsail. We make sailing accessible to all, with three options especially suited for beginners: Easy Crew, Skippered, and Cabin Cruises. Can You Go on a BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience? Many people assume that exploring the ocean requires a formal captain’s license or a deep understanding of marine navigation. While renting a boat entirely on your own, known as a bareboat charter , requires sailing experience, there are plenty of ways to enjoy the sea without any technical knowledge. With a crewed BVI sailing vacation , you don’t need to stress about managing a vessel. Our team oversees managing the necessary tasks, such as tracking the weather, anchoring in a busy bay, or interpreting complex nautical terms. You’ll have experienced staff managing onboard systems for you while you enjoy the experience. Our modern catamarans are also stable boats, which means a very low risk of motion sickness and a comfortable stay for those new to life on the water. Best BVI Charter Options If You Don’t Know How to Sail Every traveler has a different preference when it comes to privacy, budget, and daily schedules. Dream Yacht Worldwide provides three distinct entry points designed to match your personal style. Best For Privacy Level Meals Budget Skippered Charter Families and friend groups High (Full private yacht) Cook your own meals or dine ashore Mid to High Easy Crewed Charter Milestone trips and relaxation seekers High (Full private yacht) Half or full board cooked by a host Premium Cabin Cruise Couples, solo travelers, and budget travelers Private cabin, shared deck Set meal plan included in the price Affordable BVI Skippered Yacht Charters: Ultimate Freedom and Privacy A skippered charter means you rent an entire yacht for your group and hire a professional captain to sail it. You have total control over your daily schedule, allowing you to choose exactly when to sail and which bays to visit. The captain handles all the physical labor, anchoring, and navigation, while you and your guests enjoy the exclusive use of the boat. A BVI catamaran charter with skipper is ideal for families who want to cook their own meals or try local beachside restaurants every night. BVI Crewed Yacht Charters: The Effortless Private Getaway If you want the ultimate luxury of a private boat combined with the service of an all-inclusive resort, consider an Easy Crewed charter . Along with a professional captain, you get a dedicated onboard host/cook to manage the galley and handle tasks like grocery shopping (provisioning) or cooking meals during your stay. Cabin Cruises: The Budget-Friendly Entry Point to Sailing A Cabin Cruise is a smart choice for those who want to experience the yachting lifestyle without renting an entire boat. You can book an individual, private cabin with its own bathroom on a large, modern catamaran. The journey follows a pre-planned route, and meals are prepared and served by the crew. Think of it as staying at a boutique hotel that drops anchor at a different, beautiful spot every day. Why the BVI Is Ideal for First-Time Yacht Vacations The British Virgin Islands are widely considered the sailing capital of the Caribbean. The unique geography of the region creates a gentle, welcoming environment for anyone new to the water. Line-of-Sight Navigation and Calm Waters One of the biggest comfort factors in the BVI is that you can almost always see the next island on the horizon. item.title: Electric catamarans – changing the way we experience boating vacations
item.description: Learn about the R&D behind our new electric catamarans We’re excited to announce the arrival of the first electric catamaran to the Dream Yacht Worldwide Mediterranean fleet – the Fountaine Pajot Aura 51 Smart Electric . Dream Yacht’s pioneering spirit is highlighted with this exciting new addition to the fleet – and is only the first step in an on-going mission of creating more sustainable sea-based vacations. Dream Yacht and Fountaine Pajot are aligned in their commitment to sustainability and reducing ecological impact and Dream Yacht Worldwide is proud to support continuing advancements through its ongoing and significant fleet investments in electric yachts. More than 22 electric yachts will join the Dream Yacht fleet by spring of 2024. Of these, 10 will be sailing catamarans and 12 will be sailing yachts from Dufour, a part of the Fountaine Pajot Group. Dream Yacht has always been known as a pioneer in the yacht charter industry and with this bold move toward decarbonizing its fleet, they have become the first global brand to launch electric yachts at scale for worldwide yacht charter vacation offerings. Together with Foutaine Pajot, they are establishing a new standard and paving the way for others in the industry to follow – thus making a significant global impact toward more sustainable yachting. By partnering and supporting the research and development of electric yachts, we can continue to make sailing accessible to people around the world but with a lower impact on our seas and environment. Being environmentally conscious is central to our mission to protect our planet and oceans, and we are confident that our charter clients will support this endeavor. Loïc Bonnet, CEO and founder of Dream Yacht Group Cutting edge technological advances in electric catamarans The ground-breaking new line of electric catamarans was made possible by Fountaine Pajot Group’s ambitious “ Odysséa 2024 ” business plan, started in 2021. As a part of this plan, a bold collaborative platform was created with the goal of helping to accelerate technological solutions. The platform, called ODSea Lab [Observe, Design & Save], brought together suppliers, partners, and more than 60 technicians, engineers and electrical experts whose goal was an entirely new approach to a zero-emissions propulsion energy system designed expressly for the needs of yachting. Through this ecosystem of collective intelligence, the group has positioned itself as leaders in the environmental transition of the boating industry. As a part of their research, they learned that 80% of the carbon footprint of a traditional yacht was from the boat’s use – especially from the engine and fossil fuels. Another 20% was from the building materials used. The goal for tomorrow’s boats will be access to 100% decarbonized energy from natural and renewable sources; solar power, wind power, and hydropower energy stored in batteries that can maintain life aboard, as well as provide engine propulsion. In addition to this goal, Fountaine Pajot is reducing carbon emissions from manufacturing, and boats will be built with recycled, organic and recyclable materials. Now, only 1 year after the start of the Odysséa 2024 strategic plan, the Aura 51 Smart Electric has launched as the first electric catamaran off their production line. At Fountaine Pajot, the design of the electric Aura 51 has changed the way we design our boats. This is what drove us for the Odysséa 2024 plan. The goal is no longer simply to build an electric boat to have minimum impact on the environment, but to go even further by offering a new experience for life onboard and the use of the boat. This is a brand new experience for our customers. A zero-emissions experience. Romain Motteau, Deputy CEO of Fountiane Pajot. item.title: Five Sailing Vacations Where Sailing Experience Isn’t Required
item.description: You don’t need to be a sailor to experience a vacation on a sailboat. It’s our mission to help everyone feel the joy of seeing destinations from the water, island hopping and feeling the wind in your hair with sails at full mast. This is why we made sailing vacations easy with our organized by the cabin charters, where you can reserve a cabin. You can leave everything to us, from the itinerary to the sailing and cooking by our professional staff. All you need to do is just pick the destination where you want to go, book your flights and leave the rest to us. Need inspiration? We’ve got five exciting destinations to get your started… 1. Hop between the British Virgin Islands The BVIs are a group of impressive islands that separate the Atlantic Ocean from the Caribbean Sea and is known for its Caribbean atmosphere and beautiful beaches. This location is perfect for anyone who loves snorkeling, swimming and stand-up paddle boarding. You’ll be amazed by colors of the BVIs, the water is a shade of blue you have probably never seen before and the sunsets, with streaks of gold and magenta, will dazzle you. There is so much to see, from Jost van Dyke, Norman Island, Peter Island, Anegada, Virgin Gorda and Guana Island, plus many more. Find out more about our Tortola Dream 8 Days/7 Nights charter from our base in Scrub Island > 2. Spice up your vacations with a tour of Grenada Grenada’s chain of islands includes Grenada, Carriacou and Petite Martinique. Grenada is known as the “spice island” for a reason – it produces the aromatic spices such as ginger and cinnamon. Yet it’s also the spice of life of this country’s unique French and English culture that will engulf you the minute you arrive for your Tobago Cays Dream 8 Days/7 Nights cruise . The people of Grenada are warm and inviting and the beaches are world renowned. You will also be able to snorkel coral reefs among the five islands of the awe-inspiring Tobago Cays or pick up some gifts at St George’s markets. Your cruise itinerary includes: Boarding at Port Louis Marina Carriacou-Sandy Island Union-Mayreau Tobago Cays Petit St Vincent Prickly Bay 3. Enter the gateway to the Grenadines from Martinique Our Grenadines cruises start from Martinique and take you on an exciting adventure around these special Caribbean islands. Experience the many cultures, sounds and textures of Bequia, Mayreau, Tobago Cays, St Vincent, St. Lucia and Sainte-Anne in one vacation. Enjoy the coral barrier reef at Tobago Cays, optional lobster BBQs on the beach, visiting local markets and boutiques, listening to authentic steel bands or go on an excursion to swim at the foot of a waterfall. Discover everything you can do with a Dream Grenadines Premium 8 Days/7 Nights charter > 4. Vacation in Tahiti’s Society Islands The South Pacific island of Tahiti is famous for its exotic beauty, friendly local welcome and the charms of its traditional dances and drums. Kick back and enjoy islands with lagoons, lush landscapes and clearwater, home to a vast array of marine life, including vibrant coral, sea turtles, dolphins and rays. Kayak and paddleboard with Bora Bora, Raiatea, Tahaa, Huahine and Moorea as your backdrop for the perfect photo moment. A vacation in this special place is easy to organize with our by the cabin charter in Tahiti. Learn more about our Bora Bora Dream Cruise 8 Days/7 Nights > 5. Enjoy Thailand’s hongs and delicious food For the more adventurous travel lovers, Thailand is yours to discover. Get to know the country’s limestone landscapes in Phang Nga Bay and explore this Asian gem with our Phuket Dream Premium 8 Days/7 Nights charter. Let us transport you to a world of secluded anchorages, ancient ruins and Buddhist temples. Visit Koh Nakha Noii, Ao Thalin, Koh Hong, Koh Phi Phi Don, Koh Phi Phi Leg and many more.
